name: 152. Responses, containers, embeddings and assertion fills (partial row fills)
description: Variants the audit named for rows that were only partly covered: OpenAI MCP forward (plus an [EXPECT-4XX] unreachable-server probe), Responses tool_choice web_search_preview, a combined text+image+file input, include reasoning.encrypted_content, a real custom tool, an ordered Containers lifecycle (152.7a-d share h152ContainerId; /v1/containers bodies are carved out of the generic shape check), Bedrock job list maxResults, Titan G1 and Cohere v3 enum probes, and Gemini assertions for stopSequences, penalties on the wire, code execution output parts, URL context, plus the Azure transcription deployment route. Titan G1 is [PREVIEW]: the model may not be enabled in the account. Deliberately not here: passthrough computer_use (beta-header injection on the passthrough path is unconfirmed), client-sent anthropic_beta body field, Gemini logprobs (model support unconfirmed) and the native Gemini Files upload.
